suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as treatment complication. Require documented nephrectomy for renal malignancy and separately documented new or worsened postoperative CKD satisfying chronicity criteria. Do not infer CKD from kidney cancer alone. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation of the qualifying treatment/procedure exposure for Kidney / Renal Cancer
Independent diagnosis of Chronic Kidney Disease / Renal Failure and timing relative to that exposure
Dose, duration, procedure details, and relevant co-exposures where applicable
Qualified clinical assessment of competing causes and exact source-phenotype fit
